title: Deliberately wrong inputs the pipeline MUST reject
rule: CI fails if any canary is accepted. Gaps (no existing gate) are FINDINGS — do not paper over with fixture-specific checks.

canaries.expected_rejection: BodyLoop radian 1.4816501199902758 must emit ~84.8923 under UCUM deg — never 1.48 deg
BM-060 Bor LOINC 52914-9 [Moles/volume] with mass unit µg/l must FAIL; no auto-fix

canaries.expected_gate: verify/check-terminology.ts (LOINC literal without signed review record)
canaries.expected_rejection: LOINC 99999-5 must appear as a missing/UNVERIFIED review-record failure
Real SCTID bound to the wrong anatomy must be rejected
canaries.finding: No existing gate checks semantic correctness of a SNOMED body-structure binding — only publication presence (check-snomed-boundary) and review-record existence.

canaries.expected_rejection: Reference-range / interpretation flag must not be emitted when the observation has no interval (null / abstain)
canaries.finding: fhir-core omits empty referenceRange on create but does not reject an Observation that already carries interpretation or referenceRange while interval is null. Interpretation-contract does not forbid severity with reference_interval_id null.

canaries.expected_rejection: Observation older than the freshness window must not be status=present in an interpretation (must be stale or refused)
canaries.finding: docs/contracts/confidence.md defines recency for the confidence product; validateInterpretationDocument does not enforce status vs as_of age.

canaries.expected_rejection: sufficient_data=true with contributing=[] must be non-conformant (D-k)
SCTID under a published path must fail the SNOMED publication boundary
CBC marker in unrenderable[] must not also appear under states[].system_id=cardiovascular
Join must run FMA→UBERON only; UBERON→FMA direction must be rejected (D-l)
canaries.finding: Schema requires fma_id and documents direction; no bridge/direction validator exists. A mismatched or reverse-declared join still passes validateInterpretationDocument.

canaries.expected_gate: packages/provider-anchor/src/fhir/mapObservation.ts → interpretive_band_not_reference_interval (D-c); interpreter treats interval_record_kind=interpretive_band as no_reference_interval
canaries.expected_rejection: BM-190 band id (e.g. RI-079) must not be attachable as a measured reference_interval — wrong-kind, distinct from null-interval canary 05
